description: Autonomy policy for Gloamstead Orchestrator (grok-cursor + claude-code). Enables high autonomy on reversible, low/medium risk actions within the vertical slice while gating irreversible, high-risk, or external-side-effect actions. Used by Assert-ActionPolicy.ps1, Update-RunState.ps1, and resume flows.
notes: Level 0: manual step-by-step. Level 1: ask on ask_first + high risk. Level 2+: allow reversible low/med (the default for this vertical slice). Promotion/critic/new-wave planning still surface status and respect policy. All actions still respect single-writer, scope, and mandatory integration verification.
